project_info.theme: Large-size green choice combo sale with produce-styled set design
project_info.color_palette: Leaf Green, Butter Yellow, Soft Pink, Dark Green, Natural Basket Brown, Tomato Red

main_subject.detail: A vertical sale poster arranging multiple Cocoon products inside and around woven baskets of fresh vegetables, topped by bold text 'DUNG TÍCH LỚN LỰA CHỌN XANH' and a yellow offer bar reading 'COMBO 2 GIẢM 45%'.
main_subject.style: Styled commercial product photography, fresh-market eco aesthetic, lush produce-led merchandising

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'DUNG TÍCH LỚN LỰA CHỌN XANH' and 'COMBO 2 GIẢM 45%'. Product labels on Hau Giang lotus micellar water, Hau Giang lotus cleanser, pomelo shampoo refill, Dak Lak coffee body polish, and Hung Yen turmeric face mask remain visible.
items: Top Left: Giant cream headline occupying the leafy green background.
Top Right: Yellow rectangular offer banner with dark green text 'COMBO 2 GIẢM 45%'.
Bottom Left: Large pink micellar water bottle leaning diagonally across greens, with tomatoes and cabbage leaves nearby.
Bottom Right: Dark green pomelo shampoo refill pouch, black coffee body polish pouch, and woven basket filled with beetroot and vegetables.
Center/Background: Pink lotus cleanser bottle, small turmeric mask jar, dense leafy vegetables, and produce styled like a fresh market display.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Crisp fresh-produce highlights, natural-looking shadows, vibrant market freshness, clean retail energy

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a large-size green-choice combo sale. Centerpiece is a vertical arrangement of Cocoon products displayed among woven baskets and fresh vegetables, including lotus micellar water, lotus cleanser, pomelo shampoo refill, Dak Lak coffee body polish pouch, and Hung Yen turmeric face mask jar. Background is dense leafy greens. Surrounding elements: giant cream text 'DUNG TÍCH LỚN LỰA CHỌN XANH', a yellow banner 'COMBO 2 GIẢM 45%', tomatoes, beetroot, cabbage, and woven baskets framing the products. Keep the eco-market styling, visible label fidelity, and produce-heavy composition. Technical style: high fidelity styled product photography, bright styled daylight, crisp fresh-produce highlights and natural retail shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
